text:
ryan park: hey team — planning my return from 12w parental leave on 2026-09-07. school announced a new late-start every Monday that conflicts with my regular hours. can i arrange a recurring 2hr shift later on Mondays for the semester?
michelle (People Ops): welcome back early! two paths: 1) recurring manager-approved hour swap (no form needed but tag manager), or 2) file intermittent family leave for scheduled school timing (recommended if you need formal payroll coding). Either works.
ryan park: i'd prefer a formal record so payroll and benefits show the pattern. what's the best way to set that up?
lina (Benefits): file the "Intermittent Schedule - School" form and choose "recurring" with the days/times. That lets payroll code it as "Intermittent FLA - Scheduled" and it's on record for accommodations.
tara (Manager): Tara here  i can approve recurring Mondays shifted 10-6 instead of 8-4 for the semester. Ryan, tag me on the form and i'll approve the pattern so it's pre-authorized each week.
ryan park: great. will that impact my mid-cycle performance review window? I'm in active review that month.
totalrewards (Comp): Comp note: Approved intermittent schedules don't negatively impact review eligibility. Managers can request a review deferral (30-60 days) for employees with scheduled reduced hours during review windows  speak with Tara if you want that. Equity vesting unaffected for standard paid intermittent leave.
ryan park: thanks. payroll timing: do i need to submit before next Friday cutoff?
payroll-bot: yes please submit the intermittent form before payroll cutoff (Fri 5pm) to ensure the first adjusted week is coded correctly. Otherwise the change will take effect the following pay cycle.
ryan park: facilities question: i'll need recurring access to the lactation room and fridge on Mon afternoons while on the shifted schedule. who do I contact?
facilities: facilities here  reserve lactation room recurring slot via https://intranet.redwood/facilities/lactation-reserve and email facilities@redwood with badge ID for fridge access. We can pre-authorize recurring Monday 2-4pm.
michelle (People Ops): recap for Ryan: 1) Submit Intermittent Schedule form (choose recurring Mondays 10-6), 2) Tag Tara for manager approval, 3) Reserve lactation room + fridge via Facilities, 4) If you want review deferral, confirm with Tara and Comp will process. Everyone OK?
tara (Manager): Approved on my end. Ryan, tag me on the form and I'll confirm within the hour. :+1:
ryan park: amazing — filing now and tagging Tara. appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
